metadata.title: Establishment of Reporting Requirements for the Development of Advanced Artificial Intelligence Models and Computing Clusters

raw_text:
DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE
Bureau of Industry and Security
15 CFR Part 702
[Docket No. 240905-0231]
RIN 0694-AJ55

Establishment of Reporting Requirements for the Development of Advanced Artificial Intelligence Models and Computing Clusters

ADDRESSES:
Comments on this proposed rule may be submitted to the Federal rulemaking portal (www.regulations.gov). The regulations.gov ID for this proposed rule is: BIS-2024-0047. Please refer to RIN 0694-AJ55 in all comments.

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION:

Background

Section 4.2(a)(i) of Executive Order 14110 directs the Secretary of Commerce to require companies developing, or demonstrating an intent to develop, potential dual-use foundation AI models to provide certain information to the Federal Government on an ongoing basis.

I. Quarterly Notification Schedule

Covered U.S. persons are required to submit a notification to the Department on a quarterly basis if the covered U.S. person engages in, or plans, within six months, to engage in applicable activities. Quarterly notification dates are as follows: Q1—April 15; Q2—July 15; Q3—October 15; Q4—January 15.

§ 702.7 Special requirements for on-going reporting regarding the development of advanced artificial intelligence models and computing clusters.
